author: Lugolgo
quote: GTA and RDR are not the same, forcing one into other doesn't mean make it better. This is supposed to be a free sandbox experience where the only limit is my imagination, and yet I'm limited by the devs for what can be done and what can't. Is not a choice if the game punish the player for a specific play style, not in a GTA game. Why I'm forced to stay behind the toxic relationship of these two? Why Lucia had to decide what I need to do always? Why the player can't be free to have just any other girlfriend? Why everything is a qte? What is the point of the name if is just a modern RDR but much worse?
